name: pionless-job-skillset
description: Job-hunt & interview-prep skill set for Codex. Domain-specific workflows for collecting, filtering, and organizing job-search material from external sources. Currently ships onepoint3acres-interview-scraper (一亩三分地 面经 collection → topic-clustered 题库 pipeline).

interface.shortDescription: Job-hunt workflows: scrape, filter, organize interview material
interface.longDescription: A skill set for the job-hunting workflow. Each skill is a domain-specific pipeline that turns noisy external sources (forums, scraped posts) into clean, deduplicated, candidate-ready study material. Currently ships the 一亩三分地 (1point3acres) interview-experience scraper: Playwright-driven collection, multi-stage filtering, subagent-batched extraction, and cross-source topic clustering into a final 面试题库.
defaultPrompt: Use the onepoint3acres-interview-scraper skill to scrape 一亩三分地 面经 for a target company and produce a topic-clustered 题库.
